# Beyond Storage 擴充套件

這是一個為 **Beyond Dimensions** 模組開發的擴充插件。

## 功能介紹
本模組為遊戲增加了一個便捷功能：**一鍵存入維度網路**。

![UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c65179b8a9f302b88b49124670da53d81e04d95_0.webp)

- 當玩家打開任何容器（如箱子、熔爐等）時，可以透過特定的網路封包觸發邏輯。
- 自動將容器內的物品轉移到玩家所屬的「維度網路（Dimension Network）」統一儲存中。
- 提供螢幕提示，告知存入的物品組數或網路是否已滿。

![P1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9a509735ebc3850816798bdad3c321dda81bb01_0.webp)

![P2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55c7438e40f04107bd6df5e21fd133a9a82ce4e1.webp)

---

# Beyond Storage Addon (English)

This is an extension addon for the **Beyond Dimensions** mod.

## Features
This mod adds a convenient feature: **Quick Store to Dimension Network**.
- When a player opens any container (e.g., chests, furnaces), it can trigger a logic via custom network packets.
- Automatically transfers items from the container to the player's "Dimension Network" unified storage.
- Provides on-screen messages indicating the number of item stacks stored or if the network is full.
